title: Mid-Level Blockchain Developer
description: Mid-level blockchain developer independently driving protocol and dApp development end-to-end: deep Solidity and multi-chain deployment proficiency, comprehensive testing (unit/integration/fuzz/coverage), production monitoring (The Graph, Tenderly/Defender), upgradeable proxy patterns, DeFi and DAO protocol implementation, Chainlink oracle integration, static analysis tooling (Slither), L2 deployment (Arbitrum, Optimism, zkSync), and cross-chain bridge architecture awareness.

skills.rationale: Mid-level mastery includes upgradeable proxies (UUPS/Transparent), comprehensive test suites (integration, coverage, fuzz), production monitoring (The Graph, Defender), and Vyper literacy.

Integrating Slither in CI, writing Echidna/Foundry property-based fuzz tests, implementing secure randomness (Chainlink VRF), and conducting pre-deployment security reviews are core mid-level responsibilities.
Building DeFi protocols (AMM interactions, lending, vault mechanics), DAO governance systems, and professional dApp frontends with wagmi/viem is the expected mid-level deliverable scope.

Multi-chain deployment across EVM networks (Polygon, BSC, Avalanche, Fantom), L2s (Arbitrum, Optimism), and meaningful exposure to at least one non-EVM chain (Solana or TVM) differentiates mid from junior.
Production Chainlink Data Feed, VRF, and Automation integration — understanding oracle security risks (staleness, price manipulation) and mitigation — is a core mid-level capability.
Understanding ZK Rollup vs Optimistic Rollup trade-offs, deploying on multiple L2 ecosystems, and articulating EIP-4844's impact on L2 costs is expected at mid level.
Full Foundry toolchain proficiency (forge/cast/anvil), IPFS/Arweave decentralized storage integration, and multi-framework literacy (Hardhat + Foundry) are mid-level expectations.

Deep understanding of consensus protocol trade-offs, fork mechanics (hard/soft forks, replay attacks), mining incentive economics, and decentralization degrees is required for architectural decisions.
At mid level, fundamentals are assumed solid; the focus is on applying them critically — evaluating blockchain trilemma trade-offs for specific application domains and use-case fit decisions.

scoring.description: Each skill score is multiplied by its importance weight. Final score is sum divided by sum of weights.

not_ready.label: Not Ready
not_ready.description: Operates at junior level despite experience — lacks production contract deployment, upgrade patterns, or security tooling proficiency.

developing.label: Developing
developing.description: Solid junior skills with some mid-level exposure; needs coaching on DeFi protocol implementation, oracle integration, and security toolchain setup.

approaching.label: Approaching Ready
approaching.description: Deploys on multiple EVM chains, uses Slither and fuzz testing, integrates Chainlink oracles, and builds DeFi integrations with growing independence.

ready.label: Ready
ready.description: Meets all mid-level expectations: independently ships production-grade smart contract systems with upgradeable proxies, comprehensive testing, security tooling, DeFi and oracle integration, and multi-chain deployment.

exceeds.label: Exceeds Expectations
exceeds.description: Exceeds mid-level with early senior proficiency: cross-chain bridge architecture, ZK proof system familiarity, custom subgraph development, Solana/TVM development, or security audit contributions.
